facts.value: Within your study program at our Department of Business Administration, you can complete certain modules at other departments, known as import modules from other departments - including optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between the departments.

For the study programs of the Department of Business Administration, the following overview is compiled for each, indicating which import modules you can enroll in at other departments and how you can incorporate these import modules into your study program at the Department of Business Administration.
Furthermore, you cannot incorporate any other modules from other departments into your study program at the Department of Business Administration, nor can you obtain deviating credit points (CP).
